Where Every Learning Moment Is Intelligent by Design

At D2L, we believe there’s a difference between technology that sits on top of learning and technology that’s built into it. Artificial Intelligence should never be applied to learning as an afterthought. It should be intentionally designed from the ground up. See how D2L builds AI with D2L Lumi embedded in our Brightspace platform, why we’ve built it this way and the research we lean on. 

EXPLORE AI HUB
TAKE A TOUR
One Platform. Personalized for You.

Stop stitching tools together. Brightspace keeps course design, assessments, analytics and AI all in one place, so intelligence shows up where the work is already happening.

EXPLORE BRIGHTSPACE
Today’s Innovations. Tomorrow’s Reality.

Experience the exciting new innovations unveiled at Fusion 2026 and see how D2L’s evolving product roadmap is helping organizations shape the future of learning.

EXPLORE WHAT’S NEW
Real-World Use Cases for Your World

Explore solutions that align to your needs.

D2L FOR HIGHER EDUCATION

Deliver Personalized Learning at Scale

Elevate the teaching and learning experience with a modern, accessible platform that’s user-friendly and easy to track.

Position your institution for growth and boost enrollments
Increase engagement and completion rates
Unlock actionable insights with powerful reporting capabilities
LEARN MORE
LEARN MORE
 
D2L FOR BUSINESS

Tailor Learning for Business Growth

Drive engagement and performance with high-impact learning that builds in-demand skills, retains top talent and increases work efficiency.

Accelerate onboarding with programs that foster engagement and retention
Deliver sales enablement with interactive, high-impact content that drives results
Transform leadership development with expert guidance and proven learning strategies
LEARN MORE
LEARN MORE
 
D2L FOR TRAINING ORGANIZATIONS

Unlock Learning as a Catalyst for Growth

Create and deliver effective learning at scale—and measure its impact—with a platform built to help drive your mission forward.

Engage learners with accessible, personalized training offerings
Reduce manual tasks with AI and automation to streamline learning administration and delivery
Unlock new revenue with e-commerce workflows for an integrated storefront experience
LEARN MORE
LEARN MORE
 
D2L FOR K-12

Empower Every Educator and Engage Every Learner

Create a supportive, adaptable K-12 learning environment with intuitive tools, engaging content and a platform that grows with your district.

Support district-wide success with a platform that delivers data-driven insights and seamless integration
Enhance teacher effectiveness with intuitive content creation tools and integrated professional development
Engage and inspire students with interactive, personalized learning experiences
LEARN MORE
LEARN MORE
 
D2L FOR ASSOCIATIONS

Make Online Learning a Membership Value

Attract new members and keep existing ones with unbeatable learning experiences.

Engage your audiences with education programs that build careers with continuous professional development
Streamline workflows with AI and simplify content creation to scale your programs with ease
Grow non-dues revenue with e-commerce workflows for an integrated storefront experience
LEARN MORE
LEARN MORE
 
D2L FOR GOVERNMENT

Offer Safe, Secure and Scalable Online Learning

Deliver transformative public sector learning experiences that meet your regulatory, security and custom requirements.

Feel safe with a secure platform that partners with Carahsoft
Onboard and develop employees faster to improve retention and performance
Unlock data-driven insights to align learning programs to organizational mandates and goals
LEARN MORE
LEARN MORE
 
Beyond the Platform

The best technology still needs real people behind it. From migration and course design to tailored services, organizations like yours choose D2L for our award-winning, personalized approach to customer success and support that doesn’t stop after onboarding.

GET OUR EXPERT HELP
about the Artificial Intelligence Excellence Award
Top 10 Enterprise LMS
Trusted by Learning Experts

Great AI doesn’t replace instructors. It gives them room to teach, not more to manage. That’s the role we believe technology should play: clearing the path so learning and the conversations that matter most become the focus.

GET STARTED
OF D2L BRIGHTSPACE
Innovation in learning is ensuring that regardless of the bells and whistles, we’re holding onto a human-centered, learner-centric approach.
Margaret Rizzo
Senior Director, Learning Excellence
